svg.title: Kernel climb with the field
svg.text: Kernel track: our climb on each board's exact score map, with the field
Grey lines: equal score. Black dashed: hardware limit (every shape as fast as an H200 can move its data).
Solid colour: #1 at the close. Dotted: top-100 cutoff.
Source: runs/*.json scored runs; floors from the judge's records; final standings from snapshots/ (Nov 16).
